comments.body: I think `return_dict_in_generate=False` should be supported in [generation_diffusion_gemma.py](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/diffusion_gemma/generation_diffusion_gemma.py#L545). How do you think @Rocketknight1 and @zucchini-nlp ?

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body:
Hey, diffusion gemma has no autoregressive generation class atm ~~and our pipelines might not work with diffusion models ootb. I will check if it's easily fixable or not~~.  I see it is easy to fix by returning non-dict so yeah, a PR is welcome. And fyi we'll be adding a diffusion pipe in `diffusers` library with @kashif 

Also, we can add a class for AutoregressiveGeneration which will work with `image-text-to-text` pipeline, noting that the quality might not be on par with diffusion model

comments.body: Thank you @zucchini-nlp I've just written PR #46724 with `return_dict_in_generate=False`. But this PR changes the default behavior of `generate` of DiffusionGemma.
